def snap(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); out={}
    for col in 'pYNO S r'.replace(' ',''):
        cs=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]==col]
        if cs:
            rs=[x[0] for x in cs];cc=[x[1] for x in cs]
            out[col]=(len(cs),min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc))
    return out
